clips.prompt: Shen Lan in dark waterproof jacket and wet hair crosses a rain curtain toward an abandoned coastal station, wide establishing shot, slow push-in, sodium lamp flicker inside, realistic wind and spray.
Inside deserted waiting room, salt-stained clock frozen on disappearance date, loudspeaker emits distorted tide wash, Shen Lan turns toward ticket window, locked-off medium shot.
Subjective hand close-up behind ticket window: Shen Lan finds ivory cassette case labeled 沈岚 in blue ink, silver ring on right hand, shallow depth of field, no extra writing.
Shen Yu emerges from darkness behind Shen Lan, gray hoodie half in backlight, controlled gentle expression, side dolly keeps station axis, he says this is mother's apology.
Macro of cassette inserted into red-lit recorder, Shen Lan presses play, rain and tide vibration in frame, precise finger action, no warped hands.
Hold on Shen Lan listening; childhood voice recites tide table then mother voice whispers warning, camera does not reveal mother, Shen Yu remains soft silhouette.
Close-up of Shen Yu's hand reaching to stop recorder after warning, cut to Shen Lan's restrained realization, red light dies, preserve cassette in machine.
Shen Lan releases the cassette, crosses to breakwater door and opens into white typhoon light, handheld follow, Shen Yu stops inside, sea spray floods lens, cut to black.
